title: 第1622章 贵族之逆第1621章 大逆不道的新王
content_zh:
取舍，变得更加复杂且常见。
黎木只是一个普通的土木人出身，只是一个心底略显稚嫩的青年人。
再过两三纪，他的年纪，在地球上也可以被称为中年人了。
若非层次带来的眼界、身体情绪自控，以及更多观测手段的冲击，如今这种结构下的他，或许早就撑不住了。
某些时候，黎木经常自嘲，自己不是一个合格的领导者。同样的生命层次，或许换给一些历史上的人物，在许多方面，或许会做的比自己好很多。
杀伐果断的格局，无法缔造盛世。
优柔寡断的性格，也无法立足大国。
如今，大势已成。
自己往后，更逃不脱了。
而索西亚本土的一众老牌贵族呢？
困在崩塌的秩序里，又惊又怒，满心都是荒诞与不解。
他们看不懂这位“新王”的心思。
历代君王求的是稳。
江山稳固，朝堂安稳，赋税源源不断，便是千秋基业。
彻底清洗地方贵族，看似铲除了威胁，实则是自毁根基。
索西亚的天下，从来不是王权独掌，是万千世家层层堆叠、共同维系的体系。
没了贵族镇抚地方，谁来治理乡野？谁来收缴赋税？谁来安抚流民、戍守边境？
在他们眼中，这不是雄才大略的革新，是彻头彻尾的疯狂自毁。
“他是疯了！”
昏暗的密室之中，几位侥幸未被清算、龟缩自保的老牌贵族相对而坐，面色惨白，声音嘶哑，满是绝望。

如今。
这种“野火”，已经烧到了伯爵这个层次。
伯爵，已经算是大贵族了。
再往上，就是国家的中心圈子，乃至核心圈子。
桌上的烛火摇曳不定，映着众人眼底的惶恐与愤懑，将压抑的气氛衬得愈发窒息。
一位须发斑白的老贵族攥紧了拳头，指节泛白，语气满是难以置信：“历代先王清肃，皆为立威，从不断根！他如今所作所为，是要掘尽天下世家的祖根，砸碎索西亚千年的规矩！”
旁人连连附和，语气里满是无力：“是啊！水能载舟，亦能覆舟。”
“世家是地方之根基，亦是王国之根基。他今日尽数拔除，看似集权在手，实则是断了自己的手足！往后地方无官、乡野无序、民心无束，这江山还如何坐稳？”
还有年轻贵族双目赤红，咬牙切齿，却又满心畏惧：“他根本不是不懂制衡，他是根本不想制衡！他不要与世家共治天下，他要的是，天下无世家！”
“天下无世家？哼！真是敢说，现实中哪里有那种家伙。我看，他怕不是想要‘天下只一家罢’？”
一句话落地，密室之中瞬间死寂。
过往的权力争斗，无论朝堂之上如何龙争虎斗、派系倾轧，终究是圈层内部的博弈。
你争的是相位，我夺的是兵权，他谋的是俸禄，大家争的是话语权，是朝堂的体面，是更高的爵位与权势。
可这位新王，争的从来不是朝堂的虚名，他争的是土地，是人口，是资源，是所有世家赖以存续的根本。
从前贵族们嗤笑朝堂争斗皆是浮水挥拳，看似热闹，实则碰不到地方根基。可如今新王出手，招招落于实处，拳拳砸在命脉。
他根本不屑于和贵族争口舌之利、朝堂之位。
content_en:
Trade-offs become more complex and common.
Li Mu was just an ordinary civil servant, a young man with a slightly immature heart.
In two or three centuries, his age will be called middle-aged on earth.
If it weren't for the vision, physical and emotional self-control brought by levels, and the impact of more observation methods, he might not be able to hold on under this structure now.
At certain times, Li Mu often laughs at himself, saying that he is not a qualified leader. At the same level of life, perhaps given to some historical figures, they might do much better than themselves in many aspects.
A pattern of decisive killing cannot create a prosperous age.
An indecisive character cannot gain a foothold in a big country.
Now, the trend has been achieved.
Going forward, I can't escape even more.
And what about the old nobles in Sosia?
Trapped in the collapsed order, I was frightened and angry, filled with absurdity and confusion.
They couldn't understand the mind of this "new king".
Kings throughout the ages sought stability.
A stable country, a stable court, and a steady flow of taxes are a foundation for the ages.
A thorough purge of the local nobility may seem to have eradicated the threat, but in fact it is destroying the very foundation.
Sosia's world has never been dominated by the king alone, but a system of thousands of aristocratic families stacked on top of each other and maintained together.
Without the nobles to control the place, who would govern the countryside? Who will collect the taxes? Who will appease the refugees and guard the borders?
In their eyes, this is not a heroic innovation, but a completely crazy and self-destructive one.
"He's crazy!"
In the dark secret room, several old nobles who were lucky enough not to be liquidated and huddled to protect themselves sat opposite each other, their faces pale, their voices hoarse, full of despair.
now.
This "wildfire" has already reached the count's level.
The earl is already considered a great noble.
Further up, there is the central circle and even the inner circle of the country.
The candlelight on the table flickered, reflecting the fear and anger in everyone's eyes, making the depressing atmosphere even more suffocating.
An old nobleman with gray beard clenched his fists, his knuckles turned white, and his tone was full of disbelief: "The previous kings of Qing Dynasty have all done it to establish their power and never lose their roots! What he is doing now is to dig up the ancestral roots of the world's noble families and smash the thousand-year-old rules of Sosia!"
Others echoed one after another, their tone full of weakness: "Yes! Water can carry a boat, but it can also overturn it."
"Aristocratic families are the foundation of the place and the foundation of the kingdom. Today he uprooted them all. It seems that he has centralized power in his hands, but in fact he has cut off his own limbs! In the future, if there are no officials in the place, no order in the countryside, and no restraint among the people, how can this country be stable?"
There is also a young noble with red eyes and gnashing teeth, but he is full of fear: "It's not that he doesn't understand checks and balances at all, he doesn't want to check and balance at all! He doesn't want to rule the world with aristocratic families. What he wants is that there will be no aristocratic families in the world!"
"There is no aristocratic family in the world? Hmph! I really dare to say that there is no such guy in reality. I think he probably wants 'there is only one family in the world'?"
As soon as the words fell to the ground, there was an instant of deathly silence in the secret room.
In the past, power struggles, no matter how fierce and fierce the battles and factions fought in the court, were ultimately games within the circle.
You are fighting for position, I am fighting for military power, he is fighting for salary, and everyone is fighting for the right to speak, the dignity of the court, and higher titles and power.
But what this new king was fighting for was never the empty reputation of the court. What he was fighting for was land, population, and resources, which were the foundation for the survival of all aristocratic families.
In the past, nobles sneered at court battles, which were just a matter of floating fists. They seemed lively, but in fact they could not touch the foundation of the place. But now the new king takes action, putting his moves into effect and hitting his lifeline with his fists.
He didn't even bother to compete with the nobles for words and court positions.
